title: Authority coverage assessment — Chennai PT
note: Unified coverage view for partners/authorities. Combines GCC ward catchments, OSM walk isochrones over GCC∪OMR study area, outside-GCC road gaps, and a Partial CMRL Phase II Corridor 5 (Red Line) walk scenario. No fabricated ridership. Proposed metro coordinates are curated approximations.

study_area.description: GCC 2022 wards ∪ OMR corridor buffer ∪ south-town AOIs (not full CMA)

walk_isochrones.note: OSM network walk isochrones from existing GTFS stops + MRTS/metro hubs. Bands: ≤5 min, 5–10 min, 10–15 min at 80 m/min (4.8 km/h). Multi-source Dijkstra on osmnx walk graph; node buffers dissolved. Partial — OSM completeness. Not crow-flies; not population-weighted. Proposed metro stations not included.

catchment_coverage.note: Catchment coverage is the share of ward polygon area inside dissolved 400m/800m stop buffers. Geometry only — not population-weighted access.

cmrl_phase2_scenario.note: OSM network walk catchment comparison: existing GTFS/hubs vs existing + approximate CMRL Phase II Corridor 5 (Red Line) stations. Station coordinates are curated approximations — not official CMRL CAD. Partial.
cmrl_phase2_scenario.limitation: Proposed stations approximate; OSM walk graph Partial; not population-weighted; not official ridership or opening-year forecast.

outside_gcc_osm.note: OSM trunk/primary/secondary/tertiary road segments outside GCC 2022 ward polygons (OMR / south-corridor study bbox). Unmet = farther than 400m from a GTFS stop. Partial — OSM completeness; not ridership.

connectivity_need.note: OSM major-road segments farther than 400m from a GTFS stop (unmet geometry). High Gap Index wards are boosted in ranking. Inventory only — not ridership or equity.

sir_electors.note: SIR electors at assembly constituency level. Not GCC ward households; not total population (excludes under-18). Includes ACs on the OpenCity Chennai AC map (Chennai district + some adjoining ACs). Boundaries are 2021.
sir_electors.reason_not_ward: Open public SIR tables are AC-level only; booth/part rolls are PDFs without machine-readable counts.

first_last_mile.summary: OSM network walk isochrones from existing GTFS stops + MRTS/metro hubs. Bands: ≤5 min, 5–10 min, 10–15 min at 80 m/min (4.8 km/h). Multi-source Dijkstra on osmnx walk graph; node buffers dissolved. Partial — OSM completeness. Not crow-flies; not population-weighted. Proposed metro stations not included.

sources.name: CMRL Phase II Corridor 5 (Red Line) — curated stations

next_steps_for_authorities: Field-verify high-gap wards and outside-GCC unmet road segments before capital works.
Replace curated Red Line coordinates with official CMRL station CAD when available.
Add population-weighted coverage (Census / dasymetric) — SIR is electors 18+ at AC grain only.
Extend OSM street metrics and settlement context across full CMA if required.
